name: Alpha-GPC
description: Choline-containing compound (choline alfoscerate), described in research as a precursor of acetylcholine

status.usStatus: Dietary supplement · not an approved drug

note.text: A Korean health-records study of 12 million adults linked alpha-GPC use to more strokes. It shows an association, not cause.

bullets: Described in research as a **precursor of acetylcholine**, a nerve messenger
Lab and animal work was **not reviewed** on the page
**In people,** the mechanism is not established
Placebo trials in dementia: 261 and 100 people
Small, short studies in healthy young men
Stroke link in a records study (not a trial)

practical.soldAs: Dietary supplement (US); authorised medicine in Italy
practical.monitored: ADAS-Cog and dementia scales; side effects, lab tests

regulatory.text: No approved drug; sold as dietary supplement

references: Clin Ther, choline alfoscerate in Alzheimer's disease, Jan 2003
BMC Geriatr, alpha-GPC in mild cognitive impairment, Sep 2024
JAMA Netw Open, alpha-GPC use and stroke risk, Nov 2021
